Strategy: Ratio-tier preference: rank bins by the ratio band of residual to item size, preferring residuals under twice the item, then under three times, then larger, with tightest fit inside each tier; this fills bins that close soon while keeping very roomy bins intact. It can fail when the tier boundaries misjudge which bins are truly reusable.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [((300.0 - (r - item)) if r < 2 * item else ((200.0 - (r - item)) if r < 3 * item else (100.0 - (r - item)))) for r in bins]
```
